author: Lizard917
quote: The story had promise and potential but failed to deliver. The premise was kind of cliche and predictable. Also the gore and sexual content was there for the sake of it.

author: Lizard917
quote: This game is stunning! Beautiful! But more than that, it leveled up the original Ocarina of Time to a level I didn't expected even after watching the trailer. Every moment and every interaction is gorgeous and feels awesome. Nintendo has outdone himself. I hope we can see more of this in other series
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Lizard917
quote: Genius, absolutely genius. We hope this hit to the table wakes up the rest of the industry. This JRPG is a reference for the future

author: Lizard917
quote: It really surprised me how good this game is. There's was a surprise in every corner ! They did surprise me. This is a love letter to the Mario franchise

author: Lizard917
quote: I loved this revolutionary game: it was ahead of its time talking about "open world" gaming
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

author: Lizard917
quote: Just like another reviewer said: it's "The pinnacle of gaming. The foundation of what 3d games could and should be." And it still holds today.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
